01_airlock.note: Wall fixtures sit on their walls: world_decor centred a fixture at 64 - B/2, legacy's horizon (48 + 16) fixed in, so on the slim horizon (60) every sign drew 12 px high and a distant one rose off its wall into the ceiling. It now uses HORIZON + 16; only fixture pixels move (12 px down), legacy is byte-identical.
